name: Hidden Surface Rejection and Hole Filling
aliases: Screen-space Point Rejection and Hole Filling
definition: A post-processing logic to improve frame quality by rejecting occluded points and filling empty neighboring pixels with surviving points.
summary: Hidden Surface Rejection and Hole Filling is a post-processing technique that improves point-splatted volume renderings by discarding occluded points and recursively filling gaps with surviving data to create a solid appearance.
